examples.text: Der Hauptverdächtige im Mordfall Stacy und Nathalie, Abdallah Aid Out, ist zurechnungsfähig und daher für seine Taten voll verantwortlich.

translations.source_sense_description: klaren Geistes, von erkennbar eigenem Willen gesteuert

glosses: Being in a healthy condition; not deranged; thinking rationally.
Mentally sound; possessing a rational mind; having the mental faculties in such condition as to be able to anticipate and judge the effect of one's actions in an ordinary manner.

examples.text:
Shepard: What's wrong with your assistant?
Dr. Warren: Manuel has a brilliant mind, but he's always been a bit... unstable. Genius and madness are two sides of the same coin.
Dr. Manuel: Is it madness to see the future? To see the destruction rushing towards us? To understand there is no escape? No hope? No, I am not mad. I'm the only sane one left!
Dr. Warren: I gave him an extra dose of his meds after the attack.
Try to go to bed at a sane time before your exams.

translations.source_sense_description: klaren Geistes, von erkennbar eigenem Willen gesteuert

glosses: Obliged, when called upon, to answer (for one’s deeds); answerable.

examples.text: Everyone is accountable to God for their conduct.
You will be held accountable for your misdemeanors.
"Because the railway is economically and socially vital, it receives large amounts of public money and must therefore ultimately be accountable to government. [...]

glosses: Obliged to keep accurate records (of property or funds).
Liable to be called on to render an account.
Capable of being accounted for; explicable; explainable.

examples.text: True religion . . . intelligible, rational, and accountable, -- not a burden but a privilege.
